insurer: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Not specified in provided extract (varies as per Policy Schedule; examples mention 5L, 7.5L, 10L, 15L, 20L, 25L, 50L, 1Cr, Unlimited)

great.name: Room Rent
great.quote: (i) Room Rent (Any Room), Boarding, Nursing Expenses as provided by the Hospital / Nursing Home
great.reference: Section II - Coverage > BASIC COVER > 1. In-patient Treatment (page 5/37)
great.explanation: You can choose any room type without any capping on room rent, so there is no limit on your room choice or rent expenses.

great.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
great.quote: Pre-hospitalization Expenses: Medical expenses incurred up to 90 days immediately before the insured person is hospitalized.
great.explanation: Medical expenses up to 90 days before hospitalization are covered, which is longer than the usual 30 to 60 days and gives you better pre-hospitalization support.

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: Automatic Restoration of Sum Insured... Sum Insured will be restored unlimited number of times and maximum up to 100% each time... 2nd Claim (For Same / different illness)
great.explanation: The sum insured is restored unlimited times for the same or different illnesses, allowing you multiple refills of your coverage without losing protection.

great.name: NCB
great.quote: Cumulative Bonus... 50% of sum insured for each claim free year and maximum up to 100%... Cumulative bonus will not be reduced unless the same is utilized in the event of claim... unutilized Cumulative bonus will be carried forward
great.explanation: No claim bonus accumulates up to 100% and only reduces when used, so your bonus is protected even after making claims.

great.name: Organ Donor Expenses
great.quote: Organ Donor Expenses... Note: The coverage limit under this benefit is upto the sum insured and over and above the sum insured.
great.explanation: Expenses for organ donor treatment are covered over and above the sum insured, giving you extra financial protection beyond your base coverage.

great.name: Modern Treatments
great.quote: Coverage for Modern Treatments: The following procedures will be covered... g) Robotic surgeries ... h) Stereotactic radio surgeries ...
great.explanation: Modern treatments like robotic surgeries are covered up to the sum insured without any specific sub-limits, ensuring full coverage for advanced procedures.

good.name: Initial Waiting
good.quote: 30-day waiting period – Code Excl 03 (Not Applicable for Accidents)... within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: There is a 30-day waiting period for illnesses, but accidents are covered immediately, which is standard and reasonable.

good.name: PED Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED)... shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with insurer
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are excluded for 36 months, which is within the typical industry range of 2 to 4 years.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Specified disease / procedure waiting period... shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage
good.explanation: Specific illnesses and procedures have a 24-month waiting period, which aligns with common market practice.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: Post Hospitalization Expenses: Medical expenses incurred up to 180 days immediately after the insured person is discharged from the hospital.
good.explanation: Medical expenses up to 180 days after discharge are covered, providing extended post-hospital care at the higher end of standard coverage.

good.name: Air Ambulance
good.quote: Air Ambulance... reimbursement of expenses incurred towards the cost of air ambulance service up to Rs.5,00,000/- in a policy year
good.explanation: Air ambulance services are covered up to ₹5,00,000 per policy year, offering valuable emergency transport support.

good.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.quote: Domiciliary Hospitalization: Coverage for medical treatment (including AYUSH) for a period exceeding three days... taken whilst confined at home...
good.explanation: Home-based hospitalization is covered under certain conditions, allowing treatment at home when hospital admission is not possible.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: Coverage for Non-medical Items (Consumables): Items as per List I will become payable If there is an admissible claim... If insured opts this coverage
bad.explanation: Non-medical consumables are not covered by default and require an optional add-on, which may increase your out-of-pocket expenses.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: Co-Payment: Co-payment means a cost sharing requirement... provides that the policyholder / insured will bear a specified percentage of the admissible claims amount.
bad.reference: Definitions (page 2/37); Optional Covers include Smart Network co-pay and Voluntary Co-payment (pages 12/37, 16/37)
bad.explanation: The policy mentions co-payment and optional co-pay features, but the default mandatory co-pay percentage is not clearly stated, making it unclear if you must pay any co-pay.

unclear.name: Cashless Network
unclear.quote: Cashless facility... payments... are directly made to the network provider by the insurer
unclear.explanation: Cashless facility is available, but the number of network hospitals is not specified, so it is unclear how extensive the cashless network is.

unclear.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
unclear.quote: Post Hospitalization Expenses: Medical expenses incurred up to 180 days immediately after the insured person is discharged from the hospital.
unclear.explanation: Post-hospitalization cover is limited to 180 days, which meets standard coverage but does not exceed the threshold for excellent coverage.
